# Catalog models whose price moves when every graph node's Role is renamed to a string nothing
# compares with (design SUB-20). TestChangingALabelChangesNoPriceOrIsListed renames the role of
# every node, rewrites every reference to it, and prices the model again on every chip and layout
# the perturbation tries. A model listed here has a price that depends on a label.
# The list may only shrink: the test fails on a model not listed and on a listed model whose price
# no longer moves.
#
# Why: the cost model decides whether an attention node holds the engine's KV cache by whether
# its Role is empty, and treats a node whose role is "block_index_scores" as DeepSeek-V4.1's
# separate indexer. Renaming only block_index_scores moves the price; renaming only
# shared_experts does not (checked one label at a time). The fix is a typed field on the
# attention node, with a closed set of values, which is blis-schemas#67 and a contract-change
# review set (SUB-1); see also contracts/testdata/role_branches.txt for the seven sites.
deepseek-v4.1-flash
